neighbours.label: In a description of a microcontroller or similar chip, the list of its built-in parts and interfaces (timers, serial buses like SPI/I2C/UART, ADC, PWM channels, memory blocks), peaking on the count word or the first piece of a part's name. Quiet for parts lists of non-chip devices (amplifiers, routers, kitchens, cars) and for chip talk that names no parts. Exception: also fires on the word 'retake' in any context (war or sport); fights and plots that don't use that word are mostly quiet.
neighbours.short: a microcontroller's built-in parts list (UART, SPI, ADC, PWM, timers)
neighbours.notes: Cold step-in reader of L32/N8576- (drop 0.05). Labelled from own tops and probes only. Output suppresses 'clock'; the - pole fires where 'clock' is expected. Blind test written by a label-only second author.
